title: Good: cert.rs build_chain pre-computes issuer lookup structures in O(n)
description: smime-tree/src/cert.rs: build_chain() pre-computes anchor_subjects: HashSet<Vec<u8>> and bag_by_subject: HashMap<Vec<u8>, &Certificate> before beginning chain traversal. This gives O(1) issuer lookup during the walk vs the O(n * chain_depth) that a naive linear scan over the bag per step would produce. The same HashMap pattern in encrypt.rs is used for recipient lookup. Both show consistent application of the 'pre-compute once, look up cheap' discipline. Worth noting because a naive implementation of chain building is easy to write incorrectly as a nested loop.
close_reason: Positive review finding — design decision worth defending. No change needed.
